name: Drawabox
attribution: This file only indexes the structure of the free Drawabox course (lesson names, exercise names, homework quotas and links). The lessons themselves live on drawabox.com and belong to Drawabox Art Instruction Inc. Kata is not affiliated with Drawabox.

rules.warmupNote: Before each study sitting, spend 10 to 15 minutes on exercises from lessons you have already done. You do not need a full page: do what fits in the time. Rotate so nothing gets abandoned.
rules.fiftyPercentNote: The 50% rule: at least half of your total drawing time goes to drawing for its own sake, not to this course. It counts outside the study sittings, not inside them.
rules.toolsNote: Drawabox recommends 0.5 fineliners on printer paper because the marks cannot be undone. Digital is allowed for community feedback, but the course calls it an uphill climb. Kata does not care which one you use: log the medium and keep going.

units.name: Lesson 0: Getting started
units.summary: Mindset, the 50% rule, how warm-ups work and which tools to use. Read it before drawing anything.
units.tools: None yet. Decide on paper or tablet.

exercises.name: Read Lesson 0
exercises.note: Mindset, the 50% rule, warm-ups and tools.

units.name: Lesson 1: Lines, ellipses and boxes
units.summary: Drawing from the shoulder, the ghosting method, ellipses and the first boxes in perspective. Submit all three sections together for feedback.
units.tools: Fineliner on printer paper. Ballpoint accepted in a pinch, only in this lesson.

exercises.name: Superimposed lines
exercises.note: Trace over each line several times from the same start point.

exercises.name: Ghosted lines
exercises.note: Plan, ghost, then execute in one confident stroke.

exercises.name: Ghosted planes
exercises.note: Planes built from ghosted lines, with their diagonals and centre lines.

exercises.name: Tables of ellipses
exercises.note: Rows of ellipses that touch each other, drawn through two or three times.

exercises.name: Ellipses in planes
exercises.note: One ellipse per plane, touching all four sides.

exercises.name: Funnels
exercises.note: Ellipses aligned to a minor axis, widening outward.

exercises.name: Plotted perspective
exercises.note: Three frames per page, boxes drawn with a ruler to the vanishing points.

exercises.name: Rough perspective
exercises.note: Three frames per page, freehand boxes in one point perspective, then check with extensions.

exercises.name: Rotated boxes
exercises.note: A grid of boxes rotating away from the centre. Hard on purpose.

exercises.name: Organic perspective
exercises.note: Boxes flowing along a line, getting bigger as they come closer.

units.name: Lesson 2: Contour lines, texture and construction
units.summary: Thinking in 3D, how texture sits on a surface, and combining forms. Do the box challenge first. Submit all three sections together.
units.tools: Fineliner. Brush pen only for filling large black areas.

exercises.name: Organic arrows
exercises.note: Ribbons that twist through space and get wider as they come closer.

exercises.name: Sausages with contour lines
exercises.note: One page of contour ellipses, one page of contour curves.

exercises.name: Texture analysis
exercises.note: First texture is crumpled paper, as bold black and white shapes. Then two more.

exercises.name: Dissections
exercises.note: Textures wrapped around sausage forms.

exercises.name: Form intersections
exercises.note: First page boxes only. Then mix boxes, cylinders, spheres and cones.

exercises.name: Organic intersections
exercises.note: Sausages piled on each other, sagging under gravity, with cast shadows.

units.name: 250 Box Challenge
units.summary: Freely rotated boxes in three point perspective, five or six per page, with line extensions after every page. Date the page and number every box.
units.tools: Fineliner or ballpoint, on A4 or letter paper.

exercises.name: Boxes with line extensions
exercises.note: Five or six boxes per page, no more, no less. Extend the lines before starting the next page.

stages.name: The First Fifty
stages.note: Vanishing points marked on the page. Dramatic foreshortening. Number 1 to 50.

stages.name: The Next Fifty
stages.note: No vanishing points on the page. Shallow foreshortening. Number 51 to 100.

stages.name: The Last 150
stages.note: No vanishing points. Mix dramatic and shallow foreshortening. Number 101 to 250.

units.name: 250 Cylinder Challenge
units.summary: Allowed after Lesson 2, recommended between Lessons 5 and 6. Check your errors after every page, not after every cylinder.

exercises.name: Cylinders around a minor axis
exercises.note: Vary the foreshortening. Check the minor axis of every ellipse after each page.

exercises.name: Cylinders in a box
exercises.note: Build the box first, then the cylinder inside. Check the extensions after each page.

units.name: 25 Wheel Challenge
units.summary: Wheels from reference at different angles. Do it after Lesson 6 and before Lesson 7.
units.tools: Ballpoint, and an ellipse guide if you have one.

exercises.name: Wheels from reference
exercises.note: Different angles. Draw them big if freehanding.

units.name: 25 Texture Challenge
units.summary: The texture analysis from Lesson 2, 25 rows in total. Meant to run in parallel with the other lessons, one row at a time. Do not grind it.
units.tools: Fineliner. Brush pen for large black areas.

exercises.name: Texture analysis rows
exercises.note: One row per sitting, spread across weeks.

units.name: Lesson 3: Applying construction to plants
units.summary: Flow and organic forms. Draw from high resolution reference. Demo follow-alongs may count for less than half of the plant pages.
units.tools: Fineliner. Brush pen for dark areas, not for lines.

exercises.name: Organic arrows (review)
exercises.note: Same exercise as Lesson 2.

exercises.name: Leaves
exercises.note: Flow line first, then the edges, then the details.

exercises.name: Branches
exercises.note: Overlapping segments along a minor axis, with ellipses.

exercises.name: Plant drawings
exercises.note: First four with no texture at all. Last four may have texture.

units.name: Lesson 4: Applying construction to insects and arachnids
units.summary: Solid forms combined into complex objects. Every pass must end with forms that feel solid. Draw from reference.
units.tools: Fineliner. Brush pen for dark areas, not for lines.

exercises.name: Organic forms with contour curves (review)
exercises.note: Same exercise as Lesson 2.

exercises.name: Insects, construction only
exercises.note: No texture or detail.

exercises.name: Insects, detail optional
exercises.note: Texture and detail allowed if you want.

units.name: Lesson 5: Applying construction to animals
units.summary: Cranium, ribcage and pelvis, the torso as a sausage, limbs and additional masses. Draw from reference.
units.tools: Fineliner. Brush pen for dark areas, not for lines.

exercises.name: Organic intersections (review)
exercises.note: Same exercise as Lesson 2.

exercises.name: Birds
exercises.note: One of the two construction only.

exercises.name: Non-hooved quadrupeds
exercises.note: Two subjects, two full pages each. Wolves, cats, bears, ferrets.

exercises.name: Hooved quadrupeds
exercises.note: Two subjects, two full pages each. Horses, deer, camels. Rhinos and elephants count.

exercises.name: Random animals
exercises.note: Lizards, fish, anything else.

exercises.name: Hybrids
exercises.note: Combine pieces of references you studied into new creatures.

units.name: Lesson 6: Applying construction to everyday objects
units.summary: Subdivision, mirroring and orthographic plans. Precision matters more than freehanding here. Work from life as much as from photos.
units.tools: Ink. Ballpoint, rulers, ellipse guides and french curves allowed. No pencil or digital media.

exercises.name: Form intersections (review)
exercises.note: Same exercise as Lesson 2.

exercises.name: Everyday objects
exercises.note: Vary them: some cylindrical, some boxy.

units.name: Lesson 7: Applying construction to vehicles
units.summary: Measuring in space, squares in perspective and orthographic plans applied to vehicles. The 25 wheel challenge is required first.
units.tools: One kind of pen for all lines, ballpoint preferred. Ellipse guide and ruler allowed. No pencil or digital media.

exercises.name: Form intersections (review)
exercises.note: Same exercise as Lesson 2.

exercises.name: Cylinders in boxes with error check
exercises.note: Ellipse guide allowed.

exercises.name: Form-intersection vehicles
exercises.note: Primitives only, drawn through. No grids or subdivision.

exercises.name: Vehicles
exercises.note: Boats, planes and wagons welcome. Include the orthographic plans.
